testing.hotfix: DEF-002 (2026-08-17): 'HTTP 404: Thread not found' khi gửi chat. Layer causes: (1) Contract mismatch — mock upsert thread on PUT checkpoint (LangGraph randomUUID mỗi run không POST /threads) → saveCheckpoint auto-create thread (giữ 404 cho workspace khác, #18). (2) events.id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY không auto-increment trên PG → migrate() tạo sequence knowledge_events_id_seq + ALTER DEFAULT nextval (isPostgres duck-type); appendMessage INSERT OR IGNORE→ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. (3) Race duplicate threads_pkey → ensureThread (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + re-read), THREAD_CREATED chỉ khi created=true. (4) Race 404 giả — pre-check getThread không lọc workspace làm loser (cùng workspace) bị trả null; bỏ pre-check, dựa ensureThread upsert + ownedThread re-verify (khác workspace vẫn 404).
